method: Original five predicate bodies, three initializer entrypoints, static scene name lookup 0x5cf5b0, scene reference validation 0x5cfac0, animation projection 0x5d0420, generic build registry lookup 0x55a020 and SCP comparator 0x52c880. Synthetic world/scene/registry/packet fields. Build name accessor callback only is adapted.

adapters.scope: Synthetic build record name accessor returns fixture name pointer at record +4. Real name-accessor layout, loader and reference lifetime are external.

limits: No whole-game execution; callbacks and globals are fixture preparation.
Rigid initializer checks cover static scene linear lookup (scene +0x110 == 0); accelerated/dynamic resolver 0x5cf510 is outside this contract.
Finite float32 frame values only; signaling NaN and x87 exception/payload semantics excluded.
Build callback and synthetic registry projections validate lookup orchestration, not build object creation or completion updates.
IsSetAlive myset covers 256 byte indices in a synthetic backing region, not proof of the actual global table allocation.
Compiled C# behavioral comparisons are pending.
